skill_yaml:
skill: door_push
skill_type: arm_gripper
phases:
- id: descend_1
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: contact_detected
- id: insert_1
  type: insert
  generator: impedance_motion
  control: admittance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    insertion_depth:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.15
    insertion_force:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 1.0
      - 20.0
- id: grasp_1
  type: grasp
  control: position_control
  termination: time_limit
  end_effector_action: force_grasp
- id: approach_1
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1

skill: door_push
dsl_version: 2
skill_type: arm_gripper
subtasks:
- id: progress_hinge
  anchor: fixture
  target_entity: hinge
  metric: hinge_angle
phases:
- id: descend_to_door
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: contact_detected
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    entity: door_panel
    offset:
    - -0.4
    - -0.02
    - 0.35
    orientation:
      mode: none
  subtask_id: progress_hinge
- id: push_contact
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: admittance_control
  termination: force_exceeded
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.2
      axis: world_y
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: negative
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    force_threshold:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 10.0
      - 30.0
      default: 25.0
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.force_threshold
        mode: replace
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: progress_hinge
- id: push_further
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: admittance_control
  termination: force_exceeded
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.2
      axis: world_y
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: negative
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    force_threshold_2:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 10.0
      - 30.0
      default: 25.0
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.force_threshold
        mode: replace
    push_distance_2:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: progress_hinge
